subject.title: fix: copilot token cache ignores profile rotation on rate limit

question: Should maintainers accept a narrow fingerprint-on-cache fix once it is ported to `src/plugin-sdk/provider-auth.ts`, or require a per-profile/per-token cache-file design instead?
rationale: Both approaches prevent wrong-account token reuse, but they differ in persistent cache shape and multi-profile efficiency, so a maintainer should choose the intended long-term behavior before adopting this stale branch.

options.title: Refresh the narrow fingerprint fix
options.body: Move this PR's account-binding check to the current SDK helper and prove legacy cache refresh plus profile rotation before merge.

options.title: Require per-profile cache files
options.body: Ask for a replacement PR that gives each GitHub credential its own cache slot, reducing repeated exchanges when users alternate profiles.

options.title: Pause this PR and keep the issue canonical
options.body: Leave the linked issue open while maintainers decide the cache design or prepare an owner-authored replacement.

recommendation.title: Refresh the narrow fingerprint fix
recommendation.body: Move this PR's account-binding check to the current SDK helper and prove legacy cache refresh plus profile rotation before merge.
